_note: DRAFT recipes written by the FeedForward team for a student budget in France. Status 'draft': to be reviewed by a dietitian and tested in a kitchen.
Quantities are for one person, in grams as bought (dry pasta, rice and lentils; raw meat and fish). Ingredient ids refer to data/ingredients.json.
batch: true means the recipe keeps 2-3 days in the fridge and can be cooked once for several meals.
Salt, pepper and dried spices are assumed to be in the cupboard and are not counted.

recipes.en: Porridge with banana and walnuts
recipes.fr: Porridge banane et noix
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk for 4-5 minutes, stirring.
Top with the sliced banana and the walnuts.

recipes.en: Fromage blanc with kiwi and oats
recipes.fr: Fromage blanc, kiwi et avoine
steps: Put the fromage blanc in a bowl.
Add the chopped kiwis, the oats and a little honey.

recipes.en: Eggs on wholemeal toast, orange
recipes.fr: Œufs sur pain complet, orange
steps: Fry or boil two eggs.
Serve on buttered toasted bread, with an orange.

recipes.en: Peanut butter and banana toast, glass of milk
recipes.fr: Tartines beurre de cacahuète et banane
steps: Spread the peanut butter on the bread.
Add banana slices; drink a glass of milk.

recipes.en: Yogurt with blueberries, oats and seeds
recipes.fr: Yaourts, myrtilles, avoine et graines
steps: Thaw the blueberries the night before or in the microwave.
Mix with the yogurts, oats and seeds.

recipes.en: Baguette, emmental, apple and café au lait
recipes.fr: Baguette, emmental, pomme et café au lait
steps: Slice the baguette and the cheese.
With an apple and a milky coffee.

recipes.en: Overnight oats with raisins, walnuts and apple
recipes.fr: Overnight oats raisins, noix et pomme
steps: The night before, soak the oats and raisins in the milk in the fridge.
In the morning add grated apple and walnuts.

recipes.en: Spinach omelette with toast
recipes.fr: Omelette aux épinards et pain complet
steps: Wilt the frozen spinach in the pan with the oil.
Add two beaten eggs and cook 2-3 minutes; serve with bread.

recipes.en: Fromage blanc with apple, walnuts and bread
recipes.fr: Fromage blanc, pomme, noix et pain
steps: Dice the apple into the fromage blanc and add the walnuts.
A slice of wholemeal bread on the side.

recipes.en: Banana and oat smoothie with toast
recipes.fr: Smoothie banane-avoine et tartine
steps: Blend the banana, milk and oats.
A slice of bread with a little honey.

recipes.en: French lentil salad with carrots
recipes.fr: Salade de lentilles aux carottes
steps: Cook the lentils 20 minutes in unsalted water, drain.
Add grated carrot, chopped onion, rapeseed oil and lemon.
Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.en: Tuna pasta salad with tomato and pepper
recipes.fr: Salade de pâtes au thon
steps: Cook the pasta, cool under cold water.
Mix with tuna, diced tomato and pepper, olive oil.

recipes.en: Chickpea couscous salad
recipes.fr: Taboulé de couscous aux pois chiches
steps: Pour boiling water over the couscous, cover 5 minutes, fluff.
Add rinsed chickpeas, diced vegetables, lemon and oil.

recipes.en: Sardine tartines with salad
recipes.fr: Tartines de sardines et salade
steps: Mash the sardines with a squeeze of lemon.
Spread on bread; salad and tomato on the side.

recipes.en: Red lentil dal with spinach and rice
recipes.fr: Dal de lentilles corail aux épinards
steps: Soften onion and garlic in the oil; add lentils, tomato and 300 ml water.
Simmer 15 minutes, add spinach for the last 5.
Serve with rice.

recipes.en: Egg fried rice with peas and carrot
recipes.fr: Riz sauté aux œufs et petits pois
steps: Use cooked, cooled rice (yesterday's is best).
Stir-fry carrot and peas, add rice, then the beaten eggs; stir until set.

recipes.en: Bean chili with rice
recipes.fr: Chili sin carne et riz
steps: Soften onion and pepper in the oil, add beans, tomato, cumin and chili.
Simmer 15 minutes; serve with rice.

recipes.en: Jacket potato with tuna and yogurt
recipes.fr: Pomme de terre au four, thon et yaourt
steps: Prick the potatoes and microwave 8-10 minutes.
Split and fill with tuna mixed with yogurt; salad on the side.

recipes.en: Warm potato, green bean and mackerel salad
recipes.fr: Salade tiède pommes de terre, haricots verts et maquereau
steps: Boil the potatoes 15 minutes and the beans 8.
Pan-fry the mackerel 3 minutes each side; dress with rapeseed oil.

recipes.en: Quinoa and chickpea bowl
recipes.fr: Bowl quinoa et pois chiches
steps: Rinse and cook the quinoa 12 minutes.
Add chickpeas, grated carrot, seeds, oil and lemon.

recipes.en: Wholemeal pasta with lentil bolognese
recipes.fr: Pâtes complètes, bolognaise de lentilles
steps: Soften onion and carrot, add lentils, tomato and 250 ml water; simmer 25 minutes.
Serve on pasta with grated emmental.

recipes.en: Ham and emmental baguette, apple
recipes.fr: Jambon-beurre-emmental et pomme
steps: Fill the baguette with ham, emmental and lettuce.
An apple for dessert.

recipes.en: Crispy tofu, rice and broccoli
recipes.fr: Tofu grillé, riz et brocoli
steps: Cook the rice; steam or boil the broccoli 5 minutes.
Pan-fry cubed tofu in the oil until golden; soy sauce if you have it.

recipes.en: Salmon, potatoes and broccoli
recipes.fr: Saumon, pommes de terre et brocoli
steps: Boil the potatoes 15 minutes, the broccoli 5.
Pan-fry the salmon 4 minutes each side; lemon on top.

recipes.en: Chicken, rice and courgettes
recipes.fr: Poulet, riz et courgettes
steps: Cook the rice.
Pan-fry sliced chicken 6-8 minutes, then the courgettes 5 minutes.

recipes.en: Mushroom omelette with salad
recipes.fr: Omelette aux champignons et salade
steps: Pan-fry the sliced mushrooms in the oil.
Pour over three beaten eggs; cook 3 minutes. Salad and bread.

recipes.en: Leek and potato soup with bread and cheese
recipes.fr: Soupe poireaux-pommes de terre, pain et fromage
steps: Simmer chopped leeks and potatoes in 600 ml water for 20 minutes.
Blend with the milk. Bread and cheese on the side.

recipes.en: Shakshuka with baguette
recipes.fr: Chakchouka et baguette
steps: Soften onion and pepper, add the tomato and simmer 10 minutes.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover 5 minutes. Serve with bread.

recipes.en: Tofu and cabbage stir-fry with rice
recipes.fr: Wok de tofu et chou, riz
steps: Cook the rice.
Stir-fry shredded cabbage and carrot 5 minutes, add cubed tofu 5 more.

recipes.en: Chili con carne with rice
recipes.fr: Chili con carne et riz
steps: Brown the beef with the onion.
Add beans, tomato, cumin and chili; simmer 20 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.en: Pasta with sardines and tomato
recipes.fr: Pâtes aux sardines et tomate
steps: Cook the pasta.
Warm garlic in the oil, add tomato 5 minutes, then the sardines broken up.

recipes.en: Lentil and vegetable soup with bread
recipes.fr: Soupe de lentilles aux légumes
steps: Simmer everything chopped in 700 ml water for 30 minutes.
Blend half for a thicker soup. Bread on the side.

recipes.en: Chickpea and spinach curry with rice
recipes.fr: Curry de pois chiches aux épinards
steps: Soften the onion with curry powder in the oil.
Add chickpeas, tomato and spinach; simmer 15 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.en: Pasta with peas and ham
recipes.fr: Pâtes petits pois et jambon
steps: Cook the pasta with the peas for the last 4 minutes.
Drain, add diced ham, oil and grated emmental.

recipes.en: Potato and spinach frittata
recipes.fr: Frittata pommes de terre et épinards
steps: Boil the sliced potatoes 8 minutes.
Pan-fry with spinach, pour over the eggs and cheese, cover 8 minutes on low heat.

recipes.en: Mackerel, rice and green beans
recipes.fr: Maquereau, riz et haricots verts
steps: Cook the rice and the green beans.
Pan-fry or oven-bake the mackerel 6 minutes; lemon on top.

recipes.en: Microwave porridge with soy drink and banana
recipes.fr: Porridge au lait de soja et banane
steps: Mix the oats and the soy drink in a large bowl.
Microwave 2 minutes, stir, then 1 more minute.
Top with the sliced banana and the walnuts.

recipes.en: Peanut butter and banana toast, soy drink
recipes.fr: Tartines beurre de cacahuète et banane, boisson soja
steps: Spread the peanut butter on the bread and add the sliced banana.
With a glass of soy drink.

recipes.en: Overnight oats with soy drink, apple and seeds
recipes.fr: Flocons d'avoine de la veille, soja, pomme et graines
steps: The evening before, mix the oats, soy drink and raisins in a jar; keep in the fridge.
In the morning, add the grated apple and the seeds.

recipes.en: Oat muesli with soy drink and kiwi
recipes.fr: Muesli d'avoine, boisson soja et kiwi
steps: Put the oats, raisins and walnuts in a bowl and pour the soy drink over.
Add the sliced kiwis.

recipes.en: Jacket potato with beans and tomato
recipes.fr: Pomme de terre au four micro-ondes, haricots rouges et tomate
steps: Prick the potato with a fork and microwave 8-10 minutes, turning halfway, until soft.
Warm the drained beans with the tomato 2 minutes in the microwave.
Split the potato, fill with the beans, add the oil; lettuce on the side.

recipes.en: Microwave salmon with couscous and spinach
recipes.fr: Saumon au micro-ondes, semoule et épinards
steps: Cover the couscous with the same volume of boiling water; leave 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Put the salmon and frozen spinach in a covered dish and microwave 4-5 minutes, until the fish flakes.
Serve with lemon and the oil.

recipes.en: Microwave eggs with spinach on toast
recipes.fr: Œufs brouillés au micro-ondes, épinards et pain
steps: Microwave the frozen spinach 2 minutes in a bowl.
Beat in the eggs and cheese; microwave 1 minute, stir, then 30-45 seconds until just set.
Serve on the bread.

recipes.en: Warm chickpea and tomato couscous
recipes.fr: Semoule chaude aux pois chiches et tomate
steps: Cover the couscous with the same volume of boiling water; leave 5 minutes.
Microwave the drained chickpeas, tomato and frozen spinach 4 minutes, stirring once.
Mix with the couscous and the oil.

recipes.en: Microwave rice with tuna and peas
recipes.fr: Riz au micro-ondes, thon et petits pois
steps: Rinse the rice, add twice its volume of water in a large covered bowl; microwave 10-12 minutes, then rest 5.
Microwave the frozen peas 3 minutes.
Mix with the drained tuna, oil and lemon.

recipes.en: Tofu with couscous and green beans
recipes.fr: Tofu, semoule et haricots verts
steps: Cover the couscous with the same volume of boiling water; leave 5 minutes.
Microwave the frozen green beans 4 minutes, add the diced tofu and 1 more minute.
Mix everything with the oil.

recipes.en: A banana
recipes.fr: Une banane

recipes.en: Apple and a handful of walnuts
recipes.fr: Pomme et une poignée de noix

recipes.en: Yogurt with honey
recipes.fr: Yaourt et miel

recipes.en: Bread and dark chocolate
recipes.fr: Pain et chocolat noir

recipes.en: An orange
recipes.fr: Une orange

recipes.en: Sunflower seeds and raisins
recipes.fr: Graines de tournesol et raisins secs
